image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of green moss and brown earth. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible on the right, showing a broad shape, while the tail extends to the left, curving slightly. The limbs are short and partially obscured by the body angle and terrain.
